short_description: Combine an official Alcatraz Island visit with a full-day self-guided electric bike rental to explore San Francisco’s waterfront and iconic sights.
location_address: 2661 Taylor Street San Francisco, CA US 94133
description:
***Alcatraz tour on your booked date; Bike ride the next day anytime between 8AM to 6:30PM!***

###Duration

Alcatraz Tour: 2 to 3 hours 
Self-Guided Bike Ride: Anytime between 8 AM to 6:30 PM

***This is for age 13 & up***
Beginner to Novice
_______________________

###Activity details


Start your day with an official visit to Alcatraz Island, departing from Pier 33 aboard Alcatraz Cruises. Enjoy a 2.5-hour self-guided experience that includes the renowned Cellhouse Audio Tour, featuring fascinating stories about notorious inmates such as Al Capone and “Birdman” Robert Stroud. Your Alcatraz ticket includes round-trip ferry transportation, access inside the Cellhouse, an orientation video, and a multilingual audio headset for a fully immersive visit.

After returning from Alcatraz, take a short walk to our bike shop on 2661 Taylor Street to pick up your electric bike. Each e-bike comes equipped with a front handlebar bag for personal items or cameras, a rear gear rack, and a complimentary map. You’ll receive a brief orientation and professional fitting before heading out on a self-guided ride along San Francisco’s iconic waterfront.

Cruise past scenic highlights including Aquatic Park, Fort Mason, the Marina, the Presidio, Crissy Field, and Fort Point. Many riders choose to continue across the Golden Gate Bridge to Vista Point or onward to Sausalito, where ferries are available to return to San Francisco.

With a full day of e-bike use, you’re free to explore at your own pace, stop for photos, enjoy breathtaking views, and experience the city in an active and unforgettable way.

After your ride, you may return to San Francisco by biking back at your leisure. Alternatively, you can take a ferry back from Sausalito (ferry ticket not included). During high season, we also offer a Sausalito bike drop-off option for an additional fee.

disclaimers: Alcatraz departure time will be provided approximately 4 days before the tour. Guests must arrive at Pier 33 a minimum of 30 minutes before Alcatraz departure. faq_items.question: What time does the Alcatraz tour leave from Pier 33?
faq_items.answer: Alcatraz departure times (if not shown on the calendar) will be provided approximately 4 days before departure. Guests must provide their legal first and last names at the time of booking.

faq_items.question: What language is the audio tour provided in?
faq_items.answer: Thee Alcatraz audio tour is available in 11 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Mandarin Chinese, and Russian.

faq_items.question: Is the ferry ticket included to Alcatraz?
faq_items.answer: Yes, the round-trip ferry ride to and from Alcatraz Island is included in this package.

faq_items.question: Is a helmet included with my rental?
faq_items.answer: Absolutely! California helmet law is mandatory under age 18 and for E-bikes.

faq_items.question: Will you give us a bike lock?
faq_items.answer: Included FREE with all bike rentals are: helmets, front camera bags, bells, maps & map holders, water bottle holders, bike lock, and detailed map assistance.

faq_items.question: What will the weather be like? What should I wear?
faq_items.answer: Weather in San Francisco can vary from neighborhood to neighborhood! Weather can be sunny one minute then foggy the next and it’s almost always sunny and ten degrees warmer in Sausalito! We always recommend layers: dress comfortably enough for your bike ride but also consider the variations in our weather. Also, the bikes have rear racks & Bungees to strap down any extra layers. Ponchos for rainy weather are available for purchase at our shops.

faq_items.question: How long is the day rental for?
faq_items.answer: Bike rentals are for all day until closing. If keeping overnight there is an overnight fee of $25/per bike. More importantly, bikes kept overnight MUST BE STORED INDOORS and never outdoors even locked as they will get stolen.

faq_items.question: Is it possible to bike on the Golden Gate Bridge?
faq_items.answer: The Golden Gate Bridge features a wide bike path on both sides.

faq_items.question: Can children rent e-bikes?
faq_items.answer: For safety reasons, we recommend children be at least 13 years old to rent an ebike. They can do so with parental consent.

faq_items.question: How do most people get back from Sausalito?
faq_items.answer: Most people ferry back to Fisherman's Wharf as the 2 mile downhill into Sausalito from the Golden Gate Bridge is uphill on the way out!

faq_items.question: Can you rent from one location and return to another?
faq_items.answer: Yes, we charge a $25 restocking fee; many people ride from our Golden Gate Park location to Fisherman’s Wharf and vice versa.

faq_items.question: What happens if something goes wrong with the bike during my rental?
faq_items.answer: Please call our emergency hotline, 415-346-2453. We provide an en route rescue service to fix your issue.
